name: directory
title: Parish Directory: Diocese of Brooklyn (page modified 2026-05-06, read 2026-11-05)
command: pnpm diocese roster import brooklyn directory scratch/brooklyn-map-1/001-survey/directory.json
notes: Scraped by scratch/brooklyn-map-1/tools/directory.py: one entry per parish block (linked name, street, city, phone). 172 entries, matching the page's '172 parishes and 211 churches'. Merged parishes appear under their combined name with one address; worship sites of merged parishes are not listed separately. extra holds phones and stray lines.
